proposed_validation.executor: Sol max Fast; any product logic repair belongs to Astra xhigh Fast
proposed_validation.environment: Local single worker, frozen dependencies, RUST_LOG=error, stdin DEVNULL. No network/upload/remote/push/publish.
proposed_validation.clock: A new explicitly authorized wall-clock window begins before the first startup/hash/format command. Its hard deadline covers tool startup, testing, receipt writes, staging, commit, readback and process exit; never reset across a repair or handoff.

schedule_seconds_from_start.0_to_40: Read/hash inputs, retain original candidate bytes, moon info then format; review any interface/format diff and bind final formatted bytes.
schedule_seconds_from_start.40_to_80: Narrow native check (cap 30s) and exact 10-group outline (cap 10s). Stop on mismatch or fixture error; do not enlarge scope.
schedule_seconds_from_start.80_to_150: Run exactly the selected 10 groups once, command cap 70s; preserve small raw evidence incrementally.
schedule_seconds_from_start.150_to_180: If PASS, documentation check with a meaningful 30s cap; use a known matching precompiled checker when available.
schedule_seconds_from_start.180_to_240: Finalize a short receipt, inspect final input hashes and metadata; exact local commit only after all required results and sufficient remaining time.
schedule_seconds_from_start.240_to_300: Reserved closeout. Do not start git commit or readback unless they fit their caps plus process-exit margin. At or after the hard deadline start no commands, including git/status/readback.

proposed_validation.commit_start_gate: At least 60 seconds remain, all selected results are PASS, and the complete exact staged scope has already been inspected. Otherwise persist VERIFIED_NOT_COMMITTED before the gate closes; do not start a late commit or spend the reserve generating long reports.
proposed_validation.red_policy: Stop and report the exact failed/NOTRUN arms to Astra with remaining deadline; no speculative logic change, baseline overwrite, test weakening or automatic retry loop. Preserve incomplete/uncommitted state if time is insufficient.
